s05000.summary: Priya wraps her hands in the near-empty gym while Reeve warns and a hooded stranger sits still.
Priya presses Coach Reeve about the stranger and gets a cryptic lecture on waiting.
The door slams, the hooded man stands and reveals himself as Desmond, back after two years.
Priya, stung, lashes out at the room and learns Coach Reeve knew Desmond would return.
Desmond invites her anger; Priya admits she rehearsed hitting him but only wants to know he ate.
Reeve restarts training and Priya tosses Desmond a roll of tape, which he catches.

s05001.summary: On the last night bus, Juno clutches a gym bag of cash beside sleeping Bernie.
Sam teases nervous Juno about the bag; she whispers for Sam to stop being charming.
A pothole spills cash into the aisle; Juno and Sam collide scrambling, and Bernie wryly shrugs it off.
Sam shows Juno a news alert about the bank robbery; Juno sinks, calls for Plan B.
Blue lights ahead, Sam jokes about being an accomplice while Bernie asks to be woken at the courthouse.

s05002.summary: Harriet and Giles trade dry small talk over tea at their father's funeral reception.
A dripping stranger appears at the door and Giles and Harriet wonder who she is.
Margaret introduces herself as the father's partner of nineteen years, shocking the family.
Giles and Harriet bristle, tea overflowing, as Nell demands they stop and refuses to leave.
Margaret hands over the father's posthumous envelope; Harriet takes it and sends Giles for tea.
Harriet reads the letter and calmly announces he has left Margaret the house.

s05003.summary: On her father's trawler at dawn, Maya films Lucas, who curtly refuses to say hi.
Messages and a call from Jess reveal Maya's dock video of her father has gone viral.
Lucas asks who called; Maya says nobody and ends the call as neighboring crews chant mockingly.
Lucas asks how long she knew; Maya confesses she posted it, hoping people would see.
Lucas demands her phone and holds it over the rail while she begs him not to.
Lucas asks her to help him change the story; they film themselves together.

s05004.summary: The Lawson household and neighbour Dolores gather by candlelight during a power cut.
Arthur rants about the neighbourhood's ancient grid while Dolores and Winifred tease him.
River's phone flickers alive with a text from Mum; Winifred laughs and the lights return.

s05005.summary: Jonah waits in the back room; Odalys arrives and they hug awkwardly as online friends.
Nervous Tamsin hovers in the doorway and is welcomed in by Jonah and Odalys.
Rafe, changed and on a cane, joins them; everyone laughs too hard and admits nearly not coming.
Odalys insists they discuss March's incident and Tamsin sits first to begin.

s05006.summary: Kenji films a commuter on a rush-hour train, narrating his daily routine in whispers.
Kenji tells Jamal his hand is on his sister's bag; Jamal brushes it off.
Kenji demands Jamal repeat it on camera; Jamal lunges and the car erupts into chaos.

s05007.summary: At the esports finals the match ends on a glitch and officials halt the broadcast.
Officials trace the fault to station four, registered under a handle, as the panel files up.
The hooded player unmasks as Dante Vasquez; Soyinka finds the patch carries his signature.
Dante hands Petrov a drive with all evidence; Petrov orders everyone to proceed by the book.

s05009.summary: Marshal Crowe demands papers from armed Rosalind at the gate and she coolly refuses.
A phone call from the sheriff orders Crowe to hold Rosalind on a triple warrant.
Weary Crowe opens the gate, lets her pass, and tells the sheriff she never came.

s05010.summary: Priya waits for her chat group and learns Jayden is her half brother who lied about his age.
Moonbeam and Devon arrive, all the chat friends turn out to be kids, and Priya shouts.
The group laughs it off; Jayden pays for garlic knots as a peace offering.

s05011.summary: A desperate woman begs Mo to triage her sick cat, and Sam steps out to help.
Jen's ex-husband story prompts Sam's 'idiot' quip, exposing Mo and Sam's history.
Sam offers Jen priority; Mo erupts, airing the couple's past failures in front of strangers.
Big Dave and his bandaged golden retriever walk in on the argument.
Sam admits she was scared and still is; Mo cracks and laughs through tears.
Mo sends them to treat Biscuit and proposes coffee and honest talk afterward.

s05013.summary: In a blackout kitchen, Sam and Jules realize the cut phone lines mean someone is watching.
Jules kills the flashlight as headlights sweep; Sam says they sit and listen.

s05015.summary: Before the finals begin, Ray steadies twelve-year-old Ava as the countdown ticks.
The match starts; Ava battles a hooded rival while Grandpa Walt cheers over the phone.
The rival unmasks as Marcus Bell, Ray's old opponent, distracting Ray and angering Ava.
The final seconds count down and the big screen explodes in light.

s05016.summary: Kit and Leo invent an aunt for Officer Okoye and stumble over her name.
Brandt demands the trunk; Kit and Leo freeze while the dog watches.
The trunk holds only a photo of the aunt; Okoye waves them through and they laugh.

s05018.summary: Frankie bursts in with coffees, trips on a mop bucket, and greets unimpressed Officer Priya.
Frankie flirts and flounders; coffees splat, his chair collapses, and Priya notes it for the report.
Frankie hands over a soggy hot dog receipt and coaxes a smile from Priya.
Guards interrupt; Priya sends Frankie off, he clangs into the bucket, and she keeps his receipt.

s05019.summary: Tom and a silent stranger wait out a blackout in a midnight laundromat.
Tom offers his keyring can opener; she introduces herself as Dana and they share beans.
The dryer stops; Dana jokes about warm towels and they laugh as a siren fades.

s05020.summary: Kim watches a suspicious sedan while Kip on the phone tells her not to look.
The sedan driver approaches; Kip tells Kim to stall and she opens the window smiling.

s05022.summary: Officer Dana conducts a routine Zoom check-in with parolee Dan, who reports doing well.
Gus's GPS alert reveals Dan is near Fulton Street; a street sign confirms it and Dan stammers.

s05023.summary: During the tournament Wei, Jonas and Bianca run a heist and bicker about timing.
Bianca spots a man in a grey suit watching Jonas and not applauding.
Jonas confirms the money is moving; Bianca reports the grey suit has vanished as the countdown reaches ten.

s05025.summary: Angry Tess stares out a rainy bus window, her own phone dead.
Tess hesitates, then answers her mother's phone and curtly admits she is on a bus.
Tess accuses Lorna of hiding her father's departure, then screams and smashes the phone.

s05026.summary: In a blackout Poppy hunts for matches while concussed-looking Ben jokes about her risotto.
Poppy asks Ben to repeat his 'might be in love' confession, and she admits she feels the same.
Poppy's nieces burst in with a candlelit cake and matches, surprising everyone.
Poppy and Ben lean over the candles for a wish before the twins blow them out.

s05028.summary: Mo narrates the studio to a documentary camera while Big Dave teases him about a ghost.
A dripping stranger slams in demanding a 1994 session tape and they stonewall her.
She sets down a cassette marked do not play; Big Dave recognizes Lou Calder and she demands they record.
Mo starts the machine; an eerie unknown-language voice plays and the camera drops.

s05029.summary: Sunny rallies the protest team, quibbling over permit times while a hooded man watches.
The team jokingly speculates the hooded stranger is a cop.
The hoodie man is Ansel, the water board leak, with more documents and a need to talk.
Sunny delegates tasks and leaves with Ansel for five minutes, as Rhea teases.

s05031.summary: Orsolya tells Bram his dead uncle owed her his shadow and points to the coffin's odd shadow.
Candles bend and a voice mimics Bram's tone as Orsolya warns him not to answer.
Bram asks how to stop it; Orsolya says pay what is owed as the shadow lifts.

s05032_0.summary: At a foggy dawn checkpoint, the narrator describes reading drivers as a grey hatchback approaches.

s05032_1.summary: Delphine tells Halvorsen she is visiting her sister, ignoring a phone message and an empty booster seat.

s05032_2.summary: Halvorsen waves Delphine through the barrier amid ordinary checkpoint bustle.
Delphine's relieved text and the buckled empty booster seat make Halvorsen close the barrier.
Halvorsen and Kestrel order Delphine out; she grips the wheel and reverses.
A distant child's cry from a truck stuns Delphine; Halvorsen asks whose child it is as the engine dies.
